original_target.title: A phase transition for continuum hard disks

scope_comparison: The Michelen–Perkins introduction distinguishes low-activity uniqueness from unproved Euclidean hard-disk nonuniqueness. Hexagon2610.00734v1 explicitly adds a long-range attractive Kac interaction and therefore does not resolve pure hard-core disks. Its identifier is a Hexagon identifier, not arXiv2610.00734 (which is about Boolean quadric polytopes). Numerical melting, enlarged-disk percolation, rods and lattice gases are outside the target.
